incident.raw_incident_stream: ALERT: Reports of a level-5 Phantom apparition at the AWS Builder Loft catering sector. Entities are disrupting the local network nodes. 4 engineers are currently pinned behind the coffee bar. Ambient temperature dropped to -4C. EMF emissions registering at 98 milligauss and climbing rapidly. Traditional security systems completely non-responsive.

presets.label: Power fails during demos
presets.text: Power just failed across the 2nd floor of the AWS Builder Loft at 525 Market St during finalist demos. Emergency lights only, elevators stopped, roughly 120 attendees, two people reported stuck in the south-east stairwell, Wi-Fi down.

presets.label: Is it us or AWS?
presets.text: PagerDuty P1 09:14 checkout-api. 5xx_rate_pct 0.3,0.2,0.4,0.3,11.8,23.5 · p99_ms 180,175,190,2400,8100 · deploy v2.41.0 rolled out at 09:12 · region us-east-1 · North American customers cannot pay. Is AWS having an incident right now, or did we break it? What should on-call do?

presets.label: Wildfire smoke over the Bay
presets.text: Heavy wildfire smoke is drifting over the San Francisco Bay Area. Event organizers at 525 Market St want to know whether to move 300 people indoors, cancel the outdoor afterparty, and what the current air quality is.

presets.label: Crowd surge at the entrance
presets.text: Crowd surge at the main entrance of a 40,000-seat stadium after a gate malfunction. Density reported above 5 people per square metre near Gate C, three people fainted, stewards overwhelmed.
